name: Antique Armor Fossil
effect:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
author: AYUMI ODASHIMA

abilities.name: Protective Armor
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, all of your Pokémon take 10 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
